## Responsibility changed

What repository layer, crate, document, fixture family, or workflow changed?

## Contribution class and risk

Classify the change: low-risk, Rust/internal, fixture/testkit, public API, protocol, architecture, security/release.

## Layer fit

Why does this belong in the changed layer?

## Matrix and project references

List applicable Matrix sections, specification-map IDs, foundational documents, ADRs, or issues. Write `N/A` when none apply.

## Ruma APIs involved

List Ruma crates, features, APIs, or behavior relied on. Write `N/A` when none apply.

## Public API, stable code, and fixture-schema impact

Describe compatibility impact, stable decision-code changes, fixture-schema changes, or write `none`.

## Tests and fixtures

List tests, fixtures, properties, or evidence added or changed.

## Validation run

Paste the commands run and their result.

## Support-state impact

State whether `SUPPORTED-SURFACE.md` or any Matrix support claim changes. Most PRs should say `none`.

## Security considerations

Mention hostile input, secrets, workflow permissions, dependency, or release impact. Write `none` if not applicable.

## Non-goals

List what this PR deliberately does not do.
